events.description: After source validation, open six v0.3 and three v1.2 CSVs with new-file semantics and write headers. Earlier stops may leave them absent; faults during writes may leave partial bytes.
Write grid.bin and formatted grid.out/geometry.out during grid setup.
Capture timestep inputs after initialization and before initial U0 output; interruptions may leave JSON absent or partial.
Write U0 diagnostics, five initial 3D arrays, four native j=42 midplane arrays and visualization logs.
Write 14 U1-U14 time/VOF rows and interval/state table rows as calls complete; preserve all flushed rows and any partial record.
On normal completion, write eight checkpoint arrays and scalar/index metadata. No periodic field output is expected because output/checkpoint cadence is 1,000,000 and nstep=14.
Write timing/performance diagnostics on _TIMING build; a normal roster has exactly these 37 files.

early_failure_prefix_rules: Never infer an empty result from an absent file. Distinguish absent, header-only, complete-row prefix, partial trailing record and complete normal output.
Preserve every emitted file byte-for-byte, including empty/partial/malformed files; record path, size, hash, last reached writer and failure point. Never normalize, rewrite, truncate or delete.
A CSV failure retains its exact flushed prefix or partial record. An incomplete prefix is a failed/inconclusive attempt, not a successful short table.
Timestep JSON exists only if capture was reached; hash exact producer bytes and parse read-only; never regenerate.
Initial arrays/logs require U0 output to have been reached. Final arrays/scalar/index are promised only after normal final checkpoint completion.
Any abnormal exit, missing normal output, prefix/hash/copy/cap mismatch, analyzer rejection, sample fault/gap or unverified termination consumes the one attempt; preserve evidence and do not retry.
normal_lifecycle.strict_roster: Normal completion emits exactly the 37 listed native files; no glob acceptance, extra solver output, alternate canonical path or periodic snapshot is accepted. Failure may leave only a reached prefix.

csv_whole_record_envelope.treatment: Use one 1,024-byte record envelope for each header/data row. The envelope replaces, rather than adds to, exact expected CSV byte sizes.

expected_fixed_csv_sizes_separate_from_c.note: Per-file expected sizes are listed; the cap uses the larger whole-record envelope.

native_producer_bytes.canonical_copy_accounting: Canonical copies are derived nonproducer bytes, excluded from the 37 native count and 64 MiB producer allocation, included in sampled mutable-run disk.
native_producer_bytes.note: The exact 119-byte geometry.out size replaces the previous 4,096-byte conservative policy cap.

sampled_bundle_cap.inclusive_scope: Sum st_size for regular files recursively under configured disk_roots plus evidence_dir; nested roots are deduplicated. This is logical file-byte accounting, not filesystem free space or allocated-block accounting. Freeze absolute paths; a root must cover the entire mutable run bundle.
sampled_bundle_cap.symlink_policy: Sampler rejects symlinks in measured roots.
sampled_bundle_cap.excluded_storage: Immutable OCI layout is external to this mutable-run cap and separately measured/budgeted; copying it under a measured root makes it count.
sampled_bundle_cap.amendment_alignment: The prospective amendment must match the implementation 1 GiB sampled stop threshold; run config must use exactly one absolute disk root equal to the whole new bundle, with evidence nested under it.

accounting.prior_arithmetic_disposition: Previous 57,451,868-byte estimate used a 4,096-byte geometry policy cap. The source/compiler reproduction replaces it with an exact 119-byte geometry output; current deterministic native bound is 57,447,891 bytes.

open_checks: The diagnostic amendment revision 2 aligns its per-run sampled disk stop threshold with the implemented 1 GiB value. The launch config must use one absolute run-bundle root, with all mutable evidence nested beneath it.
geometry.out exact list-directed schema, units, and 119-byte bound are source-derived and reproduced in the pinned candidate image with NVHPC 26.9.
Little-endian binary64 is bound to the retained linux/amd64 candidate image and executable identity; the runtime output checker validates expected exact byte lengths and hashes.
Pressure and checkpoint history-RHS units/semantics are source-resolved in source_refs S11-S15. They are archival outputs for this dry diagnostic; no predicate depends on their numeric values.
All 37 file sizes/counts are expected source/Warden values, not measurements from a solver run. Exact independent review must verify names, calls, formats, shapes, byte bounds, cadence and maps.
Eight CSV expected byte sizes plus the timestep upper expectation are listed separately; deterministic cap uses 1,024 bytes per header/data record and does not add fixed CSV sizes.
Generalized raw directional flux/momentum, pre/post-clipping and full raw-ledger reconstruction remain deferred/unassessed for this no-liquid/no-active-slot runtime-only attempt.
